_comment: LGU permit cost and approval delay for residential rooftop solar installations. Only verified, sourced data points are populated. Unverified cities have status='unverified' and need a contributor with on-the-ground knowledge to fill in. Open a PR with a source URL to add or correct entries. Refresh annually or when DOE/LGU publishes new fee schedules. April 2026 DOE circular: LGUs must issue electrical permits within 3 working days and Certificates of Final Electrical Inspection within 7 working days, with 'deemed approved' on silence. Many LGUs have not yet adopted the new schedule as of 2026-05-08.
_unit_days: calendar days from filing to electrical permit issuance

Rizal Province (province-level reference.data_source: Power Philippines, citing 520kWp commercial project comparison
Rizal Province (province-level reference.notes: Province-level rate cited as outlier high. Specific city varies. Use as upper-bound reference for residential extrapolation: residential ~ 0.10-0.15x of 520kWp commercial fee.

Laguna Province (province-level referenc.notes: Province-level rate cited as low end. Use as lower-bound reference for residential extrapolation.

_contributor_guide: To add a verified row, file a PR with: actual permit fee schedule (link to ordinance or LGU website), residential rooftop solar project size assumed (typical 3-10kWp), median calendar days from filing to permit issuance (with sample size if known), and a public-source URL. Only data with a verifiable source goes in 'verified'. The permit_days_p50 field is null when only a fee is known. The fee field is null when only delay data is known.
